'''2024 Charity Brad Kippel LS WYS''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brad Kippel]] at the [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brad Kippel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:2024-retro-24Retro Kippel LS WYS.txt|Download]]
